rules.key: worth over 750 points, an Autarch must be included
rules.text: If the fleet is worth over 750 points, an Autarch must be included to lead it.

rules.key: You may include up to three Farseers in your fleet
rules.text: You may include up to three Farseers in your fleet, each of whom must be assigned to a capital ship (including the flagship if desired) and gives the vessel a re-roll.
rules.why: Kirja antaa rajan seka otsikkona '0-3 Farseers' etta lauseena. Ne yhdistettiin yhdeksi tarkistukseksi 7.9.2026, ja lahdelauseeksi jai kirjan taysi virke.

rules.key: up to one Dragonship for every two Wraithships
rules.text: Your fleet may include up to one Dragonship for every two Wraithships included in the fleet.

rules.key: you may include a single Dragonship as his flagship which does not count
rules.text: If your fleet is led by an Autarch, you may include a single Dragonship as his flagship which does not count against this limitation.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. Dragonship-suhdeluvun exempt-kentta: Autarchin johtaessa yksi Dragonship jaa laskennasta. Aiempi puute: Ehdollinen POIKKEUS suhdelukuun: yksi Dragonship jaa laskennan ulkopuolelle jos Autarch johtaa. Moottorissa ei ole poikkeuskasitetta, joten tarkistus on tassa t

rules.key: In order to take the Flame of Asuryan, an Eldar Hero must lead the fleet
rules.text: In order to take the Flame of Asuryan, an Eldar Hero must lead the fleet and be embarked aboard it.
rules.why: Ehdollinen rivirajoite; maara yksi on valvottu rivirajana mx=1 kirjan merkinnasta '(0-1)'.

rules.key: Your fleet may include any number of Wraithships
rules.text: Your fleet may include any number of Wraithships.

rules.key: Any capital ship in the fleet may be upgraded to a Ghostship
rules.text: Any capital ship in the fleet may be upgraded to a Ghostship. Such a vessel may not also include a Farseer or Aspect Warrior crew.
rules.why: Poissulkeva valinta aluskohtaisesti; rivi 'Ghostship 0 pts' on valittavissa.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: torpedo bombers for +15 points per launch bay
rules.text: Attack craft carriers may also be equipped with torpedo bombers for +15 points per launch bay.
rules.why: Hinnoiteltu optio; rivi 'Torpedo bombers 15 pts' on valittavissa.

rules.key: one Corsair Eldar cruiser or light cruiser may be taken for every three Dragonships
rules.text: Following this, one Corsair Eldar cruiser or light cruiser may be taken for every three Dragonships and / or Wraithships in the fleet.

rules.key: Up to one Void Stalker may be taken in the fleet as long as the fleet is at least 1000 points
rules.text: Up to one Void Stalker may be taken in the fleet as long as the fleet is at least 1000 points and at least three Corsair Eldar cruisers and / or light cruisers are already present in the fleet.
rules.why: Kaksi ehtoa ja alus toisesta listasta; ei valvottavissa.

rules.key: Yriel may be taken instead of the Hero Fleet Commander
rules.text: Prince Yriel 150 pts. Yriel may be taken instead of the Hero Fleet Commander as listed in the Corsair and Craftworld Eldar fleet lists.
rules.why: Valvottu 10.9.2026 (laivastopistokoe S5, raportti 17): Yriel korvaa Heron ja Hero Autarchin (s.318 'in place of its normal fleet commander'), joten Autarch + Hero + Yriel on enintaan yksi, ja pakollinen Autarch (yli 750) tayttyy kenella tahansa kolmesta. Aiemmin Heron tai Yrielin johtama laivasto sai virheen 'Autarch missing'.

rules.key: An Eldar Hero must lead the fleet in order to use Corsair Eldar vessels as reserves
rules.text: An Eldar Hero must lead the fleet in order to use Corsair Eldar vessels as reserves. Following this, one Corsair Eldar cruiser or light cruiser may be taken for every three Dragonships and / or Wraithships in the fleet. Corsair Eldar escort vessels may be taken in the same ratio of no more than one for every three Shadowhunters in the fleet.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): listan kentta res_ok, jossa lupa on ehdollinen (needs_re = Eldar Hero tai Prince Yriel). Eldar ja Craftworld Eldar ovat s.14:n rotuluettelossa eri rotuja, joten ilman tata lupaa rotuportti estaisi koko asian. Suhdeluvut tulevat kirjan yleisesta 1:3-saannosta (s.14).

rules.key: He must be embarked aboard the Flame of Asuryan if it is present
rules.text: He must be embarked aboard the Flame of Asuryan if it is present, in which case his cost is 125 points.
rules.why: Sama tarkistus kuin Corsair-listoilla (listan kentta aboard). Samalla korjattu: saanto 'Flame of Asuryan needs an Eldar Hero (or Yriel)' nimesi Yrielin otsikossaan mutta ei laskenut hanta, joten Yriel + Flame hylattiin.

entries.name: Farseers
entries.why: Kirja kirjoittaa rivin '0-3 Farseers.....+30 pts' ilman sivuviitetta, joten sen poimii UPGRADE-kaava. Maararajoite jai nimeen 7.9.2026 asti; se oli yhdeksas ja viimeinen tapaus siita perheesta.

notes: Ghostship maksaa kirjassa 'Free'; sovellus lukee sen nollaksi.
Aspect Warrior Host on kirjassa sivuviitteella (pg. 305), mutta se ei ole alusprofiili vaan laivastopaivitys. FIXES-taulu poistaa viitteen ja merkitsee rivin paivitykseksi.
Prince Yriel on kirjassa oma laatikkonsa sivulla 319 ja korvaa Hero-komentajan seka tassa etta Corsair-listalla.
